zh.title: 王青 × 伦敦时装周｜从人物造型到时尚叙事
zh.summary: 把形象准备、场景安排与人物摄影作为连续的制作任务，让王青的造型在伦敦街头、建筑与活动语境中形成可供传播的时尚内容。
zh.preview: 刺绣细节、完整造型与城市环境分别提供不同的观看尺度。围绕同一人物统筹准备与拍摄，使时装周内容既有形象辨识度，也有伦敦现场的具体背景。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 统筹形象准备、场景安排和人员沟通，并结合影像制作，将人物造型落实到具体拍摄场景。
zh.context: 伦敦时装周汇集品牌、设计师、艺人和媒体的关注，人物如何出现也成为时尚表达的一部分。王青的 2025 年项目围绕形象准备与人物内容展开，需要让造型在不同场景中保持清晰的表达。

narrativeSections.heading: 时装周语境中的人物辨识度
narrativeSections.text: 人物内容既要呈现服饰，也要保留艺人自身的形象。深色刺绣造型贯穿街头、建筑与活动画面，为不同场景提供共同的视觉线索，使一组影像能够围绕同一人物展开。

narrativeSections.heading: 准备工作决定拍摄如何发生
narrativeSections.text: 形象准备与场景选择相互影响，人员安排则决定这些想法如何进入制作。我们的统筹覆盖这些相互依赖的环节，将造型、场景与拍摄所需的协作放在同一项任务中处理。

narrativeSections.heading: 由细节走向完整语境
narrativeSections.text: 近景保留造型细节，完整人物画面展示穿着关系，环境画面补充伦敦的空间背景。这些不同尺度让内容可用于人物介绍与时装周回顾，也为后续时尚合作沟通提供形象参考。

deliverables: 人物形象准备与场景安排
拍摄人员沟通及制作协调
王青造型近景、完整人物与环境影像
outcomes: 形成以刺绣造型为线索、包含人物细节和伦敦场景的时装周内容。
影像可为艺人形象传播及后续时尚项目沟通提供具体的视觉参考。

en.title: Wang Qing at London Fashion Week | A Look in Context
en.summary: Image preparation, location coordination and photography placed Wang Qing’s look within London’s streets, architecture and event settings, creating fashion content with a sense of place.
en.preview: Close details, complete looks and city settings offer different ways into the same appearance. Coordinating preparation and photography gave the content both a recognisable subject and a London context.
en.role: Vivian Adventure coordinated image preparation, settings and people liaison alongside photography, taking the talent’s look into the practical conditions of the shoot.
en.context: London Fashion Week concentrates attention across brands, designers, talent and media. For Wang Qing’s 2025 project, image preparation and content production needed to make the look legible across different settings within that fashion context.

narrativeSections.heading: A recognisable thread
narrativeSections.text: The dark embroidered look runs through street, architectural and event imagery. It gives the set a consistent point of reference while leaving room for the artist’s own presence, allowing the clothing and the person to be read together.

narrativeSections.heading: The production behind an appearance
narrativeSections.text: Image preparation informs the setting; the setting brings its own coordination needs. Our scope covered these dependencies, organising the look, locations and people involved as parts of the same photographic assignment.

narrativeSections.heading: Detail, silhouette and place
narrativeSections.text: Close portraits retain detail, full-length views show the complete look, and wider frames introduce London. Together they offer material for talent profiles and fashion week recaps, with a visual reference for later fashion conversations.

deliverables: Wang Qing detail portraits, complete looks and environmental imagery
outcomes: The fashion week content carries a consistent embroidered look across portraits and London settings.
The imagery offers a reference for artist communication and future fashion project discussions.
